resources.string: On your computer, in the folder that holds agentx.json, run agentx app pair. Then type the address and the pairing code it shows.
Type the address that starts with https:// (the part before /app).
A pairing code has 8 letters or digits, like ABCD-EFGH.
Could not reach the computer. Check that Tailscale is on, on this phone and on the computer, and try again.
Paired. To get reminders when you arrive at or leave a place, turn on place reminders below. You can do it later from the phone app\'s Alerts tab.

AgentX uses your location in the background, even when the app is closed, to notice when you arrive at or leave the places you saved. It tells your computer only which place and whether you arrived or left. It never sends where you are.
Place reminders are off. This phone watches no places.

Place reminders can\'t fire: AgentX may no longer use the location all the time. Tap Open Android settings for AgentX, then Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow all the time with Use precise location on.
No places yet. Add one in the phone app\'s Alerts tab, or on the computer\'s Places page.
This phone stops watching places and forgets its pairing. To remove its key on the computer too, run agentx app revoke there.
Reminders only work with the app closed if AgentX may use the location all the time. On the next screen, tap Location if needed, then choose Allow all the time and keep Use precise location on.

AgentX may not use this phone\'s precise location, so it can\'t notice when you arrive somewhere. To change this, open Android settings for AgentX, tap Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow all the time with Use precise location on.

AgentX may use the location only while it is open, so reminders would not fire with the app closed. To change this, open Android settings for AgentX, tap Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow all the time.
This phone is no longer paired with the computer. Tap Forget this computer, then pair again.
Could not reach the computer. Places are checked again when it is reachable.
Location all the time is not allowed, so no place is watched. Turn place reminders off and on again.
Location is off on this phone. Turn it on in quick settings; places are watched again at the next check.
Android watches at most 100 places per app. Remove some places.
Android could not watch the places: %1$s
Pair your watch or headset with this phone, as for phone calls. Tap Start: the watch rings. Answer on the watch, then speak after each beep. Hang up on the watch to end.
Choose the agent to talk to.
No agent is online. Check that AgentX is running on the computer.
Could not reach the computer. Check that Tailscale is on, on this phone and on the computer.
Ringing your watch. Answer on the watch.
The watch did not answer. Tap Start to ring it again.
Another call is on, so the watch can\'t ring now.
This phone does not let AgentX place calls.
Call ended. The conversation is in the phone app\'s Chat.
AgentX may not use the microphone, so it can\'t hear you. Allow it in Android settings for AgentX, then tap Start.
No watch or headset took the call, so it is on the phone\'s speaker. Talking to %1$s.
You said: %1$s. Waiting for the answer…
You called AgentX from the watch. Connecting…

Call AgentX from the watch\'s contacts instead of tapping Start here. Tap Set up: Android asks to let AgentX redirect calls, then the phone\'s Contacts app opens with an AgentX contact to save. Then sync your contacts to the watch in its phone app.

On. Call the AgentX contact (%1$s) from the watch: the call is not placed, the watch rings back with %2$s and answers by itself. Other numbers are not changed. To turn it off, remove AgentX as the call redirecting app in Android settings.
AgentX may not redirect calls, so a call from the watch goes out as a normal call to a number that does not exist. Tap Set up to ask again.
This phone has no Contacts app to save the contact. Add a contact named AgentX with the number %1$s by hand.
You are talking to %1$s. Speak after the beep.
I didn\'t hear anything. Speak after the beep, or hang up.
I didn\'t catch that. Please say it again.
The agent finished without an answer.
I could not reach your computer. Check the connection.
This phone is no longer paired with your computer. Pair it again in the AgentX app.
Something went wrong. Ending the call.
